evidence.reason: render_units collects every recursive template under systemd/ whose basename starts with `crq-`, but writes rendered output to `output / source.name`. If the target contains two templates with the same basename in different directories, the later write silently overwrites the earlier one and the returned paths list contains the same file twice. No duplicate-basename check exists before outputs are created. Rejecting duplicate unit basenames before rendering/writing is the smallest compatible correctness fix.
